title: LBJ's secret mission to Prime Minister Sato on textile exports

tellings.quote: LBJ wants you to go on a very secret mission to Tokyo

plain: In 1964, Harold Malmgren, then a young trade official and later a presidential adviser, says he was told that "LBJ wants you to go on a very secret mission to Tokyo" to deal with Japan's Prime Minister Eisaku Sato over Japanese textile exports. Malmgren tells it first-hand on the show and names Christian Herter as part of the story. It shows how close to the top of government he says he worked.
